fields.climate: desert; mostly hot, dry, dusty; tropical in extreme south
fields.terrain: predominately desert plains and sand dunes; flat to rolling plains in south; hills in north
fields.resources: uranium, coal, iron ore, tin, phosphates, gold, molybdenum, gypsum, salt, petroleum
fields.farm: millet, cowpeas, sorghum, onions, milk, sugarcane, cabbages, cassava, groundnuts, tomatoes
fields.exports: gold, oil seeds, uranium and thorium ore, radioactive chemicals, refined petroleum
fields.industries: uranium mining, petroleum, cement, brick, soap, textiles, food processing, chemicals, slaughterhouses
fields.languages: Hausa, Zarma, French (official), Fufulde, Tamashek, Kanuri, Gurmancema, Tagdal
fields.religions: Muslim 95.5%, ethnic religionist 4.1%, Christian 0.3%, agnostics and other 0.1%
fields.military: 18 is the legal minimum age for selective compulsory or voluntary military service for unmarried men and women; 24-month service term
